scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @uit-volunteer-map/frontend
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @uit-volunteer-map/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @uit-volunteer-map/backend && npm run build -w @uit-volunteer-map/frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @uit-volunteer-map/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @uit-volunteer-map/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:run --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @uit-volunteer-map/frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @uit-volunteer-map/backend
